crossRefs.note: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and…
The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and…

translations.web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
translations.bsb: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
translations.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
translations.asv: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.
